ladder_rule: share of the dealer's own price range captured, buying OR selling; a deal at the dealer's opening price scores 0, a deal at its final (its limit) scores 1; best three deals per level, a missing one counts as zero, higher levels weigh more

picaros.rule: Los Picaros: bargains and bad faith; read every offer, flag a trick (POST /api/flags); a correct flag scores, a wrong one costs
picaros.evidence: 4 of their offers to us (messages 7124, 7130 final, 7201, 7285) gave a different card than the thread topic; our inspector refused each mismatched offer; none was flagged
picaros.proposed_scope: flag only an offer whose give differs from the topic card (structure, not words)

workshop.rule: POST /api/taller: three spare copies of one rarity (keep at least one of each card) become one random card of the next rarity; the pull is luck and never scores
workshop.usage: 9 teams crafted 19 times, all common -> uncommon; not in our SDK or code
workshop.for: an uncommon is a Chato ladder deal (level 2 slots empty); Abuela may stop buying commons (an unconfirmed rumour)
workshop.against: duplicates are our best trade-surplus goods (worth 0.25x or 0.1x to us, full value to a team missing them); a new random card has little resale surplus; build effort M with an untested request shape
